resources.string: Turns your Android phone into a magnifier for soldering and fine work.

Pick the macro, main or telephoto lens, zoom with the slider or a pinch, and use autofocus or set the focus by hand. Adjust exposure and white balance (and lock it), turn on the grid overlay to line up tiny parts, and light your work with the torch, at an adjustable brightness on phones that support it. Freeze or rotate the image, and save snapshots to your gallery.
Everything stays on this phone. Snapshots save to your gallery and nothing is uploaded.

MicroDeck checks GitHub\'s latest-release page for a new version (at startup if \"Check for updates at startup\" is on, or when you tap Check for updates). Download and install gets the update from GitHub and checks its SHA-256 and its signature before handing it to Android. Android asks you once to let MicroDeck install apps, and asks you to confirm each update. No telemetry, no IDs, nothing about your photos or settings is sent.
